## Editorial review

### Content
- [ ] Original analysis is clear
- [ ] Claims are supported by primary sources
- [ ] No confidential, proprietary, or employer-specific information
- [ ] Practical value is obvious to the reader
- [ ] Title and summary are accurate rather than sensational

### Publication
- [ ] Website build passes
- [ ] Links work
- [ ] Mobile layout reviewed
- [ ] Distribution copy reviewed
- [ ] Author approves publication

Merging this pull request is the publication approval step.
